verses.en: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, and Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took men:
verses.sm: UA ave ni tagata e Kom le atalii o Isara, o le atalii ia o Koato, o le atalii ia o Levi,o Tatano foi ma Apiramo o atalii o Eliapo, o Ono foi le atalii o Peleto, o le fanauga a Reupena ia;

verses.en: And they rose up before Moses, with certain of the children of Israel, two hundred and fifty princes of the assembly, famous in the congregation, men of renown:
verses.sm: ma ua latou laga mai ia Mose, na faatasi foi ma i latou nisi tagata o le fanauga a Isaraelu e lua selau ma le limagafulu, o alii i latou o le faapotopotoga, e ta‘ua i le faapotopotoga, o tagata mamalu ;

verses.en: And they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said unto them, Ye take too much upon you, seeing all the congregation are holy, every one of them, and the LORD is among them: wherefore then lift ye up yourselves above the congregation of the LORD?
verses.sm: ua latou faapotopotoina i latou ia Mose ma Arona, ma latou faapea atu ia te i laua, Ua oulua faamaualuga lava, auā ua paia le faapotopotoga uma lava, o loo ia te i latou foi o Ieova, o lenei, se a ea le mea ua oulua faasili ai oulua i le faapotopotoga a Ieova ?

verses.en: And when Moses heard it, he fell upon his face:
verses.sm: Ua faalogo i ai Mose, ona faapaūfao ai lea o ia.

verses.en: And he spake unto Korah and unto all his company, saying, Even to morrow the LORD will shew who are his, and who is holy; and will cause him to come near unto him: even him whom he hath chosen will he cause to come near unto him.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi o ia ia Koru ma i latou uma na ‘au faatasi ma ia, ua faapea atu, A taeao e faailoa mai ai e Ieova po o ai ona tagata, po o ai foi ua paia ; e faalatalataina foi e ia lea tagata ia te ia; o le ua filifilia e ia, na te faalatalataina o ia ia te ia.

verses.en: This do; Take you censers, Korah, and all his company;
verses.sm: Ia outou faia lenei mea ; ina au mai ia e outou o salefu, o Koru ma i latou uma o e ‘au faatasi ma ia ;

verses.en: And put fire therein, and put incense in them before the LORD to morrow: and it shall be that the man whom the LORD doth choose, he shall be holy: ye take too much upon you, ye sons of Levi.
verses.sm: ma tuu i ai ni afi, ma avane i ai mea manogi i luma o Ieova a taeao; o le tagata foi e filifilia e Ieova e paia lava o ia; ua outou faamaualuga lava o outou na le fanauga a Levi.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Hear, I pray you, ye sons of Levi:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Mose ia Koru, Ina faalogologo mai ia o outou na le fanauga a Levi;

verses.en: Seemeth it but a small thing unto you, that the God of Israel hath separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself to do the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister unto them?
verses.sm: se mea itiiti ea ia te outou ina ua vavaeeseina outou e le Atua o Isaraelu i le faapotopotoga o Isaraelu, ina ia faalatalataina outou ia te ia e auauna i le galuega o le malumalu o leova, e tutū foi i luma o le faapotopotoga e auauna ia te i latou?

verses.en: And he hath brought thee near to him, and all thy brethren the sons of Levi with thee: and seek ye the priesthood also?
verses.sm: Ua na faalatalataina foi oe ia te ia atoa ma ou uso uma lava o le fanauga a Levi faatasi ma oe, a e tou te mananao ea atoa ma lava lena ua outou faapotopotoina ai,

verses.en: For which cause both thou and all thy company are gathered together against the LORD: and what is Aaron, that ye murmur against him?
verses.sm: o oe ma i latou uma e ua ‘au faatasi ma oe, e tetee atu ia Ieova; a o Arona, o ai ea o ia tou te muimui ai ia to ia ?

verses.en: And Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab: which said, We will not come up:
verses.sm: Ona auiua atu lea e Mose se tasi e valaau ia Tatano ma Apiramo o atalii o Eliapo ; a ua la tali mai ai, Ma te le o atu lava ;

verses.en: Is it a small thing that thou hast brought us up out of a land that floweth with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, except thou make thyself altogether a prince over us?
verses.sm: se mea itiiti ea ina ua e aveina ae i matou ai le nuu o loo tafe ai le suāsusu ma le meli, ina ia oti i matou ia te oe i le vao, a e matuā fai ea oe mo matou alii ?

verses.en: Moreover thou hast not brought us into a land that floweth with milk and honey, or given us inheritance of fields and vineyards: wilt thou put out the eyes of these men? we will not come up.
verses.sm: I le ma lenei foi, ua e le faaootia i matou i le nuu o loo tafe ai le suāsusu ma le meli, ua e le foaiina mai foi ia te i matou ni fanua ma ni tovine e fai mo matou tofi ; a e sasali ea mata o nei tagata ? ma te le o atu lava.

verses.en: And Moses was very wroth, and said unto the LORD, Respect not thou their offering: I have not taken one ass from them, neither have I hurt one of them.
verses.sm: Ona ita tele lava lea o Mose, ua na fai atu foi ia Ieova, Aua e te silasila i a latou taulaga ; ou te lei avea sa latou asini e tasi, ou te lei agaleaga atu foi i so latou e toatasi.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Korah, Be thou and all thy company before the LORD, thou, and they, and Aaron, to morrow:
verses.sm: Ua fai atu foi Mose ia Koru, Ina o mai ia i luma o Ieova a taeao, o oe ma i latou uma o e ‘au faatasi ma oe, o oe, ma i latou, atoa foi ma Arona.

verses.en: And take every man his censer, and put incense in them, and bring ye before the LORD every man his censer, two hundred and fifty censers; thou also, and Aaron, each of you his censer.
verses.sm: la taitasi foi le tagata ma au mai lana salefu, ma avane i ai ni mea .manogi, ma ia outou au mai taitasi e le tagata lana salefu i lurna o leova, e lua selau ma le lima sefulu o salefu ; o oe foi ma Arona ia taitasi ma lana salefu.

verses.en: And they took every man his censer, and put fire in them, and laid incense thereon, and stood in the door of the tabernacle of the congregation with Moses and Aaron.
verses.sm: Ona latou au mai ai lea taitoatasi ma lana salefu, ma latou avane i ai ni afi, ma avane i ai meamanogi,ua latou tutū faatasi foi ma Mose ma Arona i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And Korah gathered all the congregation against them unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto all the congregation.
verses.sm: Ooa faapotopotoina ai lea e Koru o le faapotopotoga uma lava i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga e tetee ia te i laua ; ona faaali mai ai lea o le pupula o Ieova i le faapotopotoga uma lava.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai lea o Ieova ia Mose ma Arona, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment.
verses.sm: Ina vavae ese ia oulua i lenei faapotopotoga, seia on faaumatia i latou e pei o se emo o le mata.

verses.en: And they fell upon their faces, and said, O God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and wilt thou be wroth with all the congregation?
verses.sm: Ona faapauufao ai lea o i laua, ua faapea atu, Le Atua e, o le Atua o agaga o tagata uma, a agasala le tagata e toatasi, e te toasa mai ai ea i le faapotopotoga uma lava?

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o le ALII ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
verses.sm: ua faapea mai, la'e fai atu I le faapotopotoga, ia faapea atu, lua o ese atu ia outou i itu uma o fale ie o Koru, ma Tatano, ma Apiramo.

verses.en: And Moses rose up and went unto Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.
verses.sm: Ona tulai ai lea o Mose, ua alu atu ia Tatano ma Apiramo, ua mulimuli atu foi ia te ia toeaina o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And he spake unto the congregation, saying, Depart, I pray you, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of their's, lest ye be consumed in all their sins.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia i le faapotopotoga, ua faapea atu, Ou te aioi atu, ia outou o ese i fale ie o ia tagata amio ieaga, aua foi ne‘i papai atu i sina a latou mea, ina ne‘i fano outou i a latou agasala uma,

verses.en: So they gat up from the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side: and Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood in the door of their tents, and their wives, and their sons, and their little children.
verses.sm: Ona o ese ai lea o i latou i itu uma o fale ie o Koru, ma Tatano, ma Apiramo ; ona ulu fafo ai lea o Tatano ma Apiramo, ua tutu i faitotoa o laua fale ie, ma a la avā, ma o laua atalii, ma a la tama iti,

verses.en: And Moses said, Hereby ye shall know that the LORD hath sent me to do all these works; for I have not done them of mine own mind.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mose, O le mea lava lenei tou te iloa ai na auina mai a‘u e Ieova e fai ia galuega uma, a e lei fai i lo‘u lava loto.

verses.en: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they be visited after the visitation of all men; then the LORD hath not sent me.
verses.sm: Afai e oti ia tagata e pei o le oti o tagata uma, pe oo ia te i latou e pei ona oo i tagata uma, ona iloa lea ua le auina a‘u e leova.

verses.en: But if the LORD make a new thing, and the earth open her mouth, and swallow them up, with all that appertain unto them, and they go down quick into the pit; then ye shall understand that these men have provoked the LORD.
verses.sm: A e afai e faia e Ieova le mea fou, ma faamaga le gutu o le eleele, ma folo ia te i latou, ma mea uma o loo aa te i latou, ma latou o ifo i seoli o ola lava, ona outou iloa ai lea ua ‘ino‘ino ia tagata ia leova.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as he had made an end of speaking all these words, that the ground clave asunder that was under them:
verses.sm: Ua uma ona fai atu e ia o ia upu uma, ona māvae ai lea o le eleele i lalo o i latou.

verses.en: And the earth opened her mouth, and swallowed them up, and their houses, and all the men that appertained unto Korah, and all their goods.
verses.sm: Ua faamaga le gutu o le eleele, ua folo ifo ia te i latou, ma o latou aiga, atoa ma tagata uma na ia Koru, ma a latou mea uma.

verses.en: They, and all that appertained to them, went down alive into the pit, and the earth closed upon them: and they perished from among the congregation.
verses.sm: Ua o ifo i seoli i latou ma i latou uma e na ia i latou o ola lava, ona toe soo ane loa o le eleele i luga ia te i latou; ona fano ai lea o i latou ai le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And all Israel that were round about them fled at the cry of them: for they said, Lest the earth swallow us up also.
verses.sm: Ona sosola ai lea i lo latou alalaga o Isaraelu uma sa vagavagai ia te i latou, auā na latou faapea ane, Ina ne‘i foloina i tatou e le eleele.

verses.en: And there came out a fire from the LORD, and consumed the two hundred and fifty men that offered incense.
verses.sm: Ua oo atu foi le afi mai ia Ieova, ua faaumatia ai ia tagata e toalua selau ma le toalima sefulu o e na avatu mea manogi e mu.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Speak unto Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter thou the fire yonder; for they are hallowed.
verses.sm: Ia e fai atu ia Eleasaro le atalii o Arona le ositaulaga na te aveina ae salefu ai totonu mea mamao ; auā e paia ia mea.

verses.en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates for a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
verses.sm: 0 salefu a ia tagata na agasala i o latou lava agaga ia fai a‘i mea salalafa lautetele e fai ma ufiufi o le fata faitaulaga ; auā na latou aveina atu ai i luma o Ieova, o le mea lea ua paia ai lava ia mea ; e fai foi ia mea ma faailoga i le fanauga a Isaraelu.

verses.en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad plates for a covering of the altar:
verses.sm: Ona ave ai lea e Eleasaro le faitaulaga o salefu ‘apa memea, na faitaulaga ai e na susunuina, ua faalauteleina ia e fai ma ufiufi o le fata faitaulaga.

verses.en: To be a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which is not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
verses.sm: O le faamanatuga lea i le fanauga & Isaraelu, ina ne‘i faalatalata atu -se tagata ese, e le o le fanau a Arona, e mu ai mea manogi i luma o Ieova; ina ne‘i avea o ia pei o Koru ma e sa ‘au faatasi ma ia ; e pei o le afioga a Ieova na fai atu e Mose ia te ia.

verses.en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
verses.sm: O le taeao na muimui ai le faapotopotoga uma o le fanauga a Isaraelu ia Mose ma Arona, ua faapea mai, Ua fasiotia e oulua le nuu o leova.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.sm: Ua aofia mai le faapotopotoga e tetee ia Mose ma Arona, ona latou vaavaai atu ai lea i le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga, faautā, ua ufitia i le ao, ua faaali mai ai foi le pupula o Ieova.

verses.en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o Mose ma Arona i luma o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga.

verses.en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
verses.sm: Ona fetalai mai ai lea o Ieova ia Mose, ua faapea mai,

verses.en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
verses.sm: Ina o ese ia oulua i lenei faapotopotoga, seia ou faaumatia i latou e pei o se emo o le mata. Ona la faapauufao ai lea.

verses.en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Mose ia Arona, Ia e tago i le salefu, ma avane i ai se afi ai le fata faitaulaga, ma avane i ai ni mea manogi, ma ia e vave alu i le faapotopotoga, ma fai se togiola mo i latou; auā ua alu atn le toasa mai ia Ieova; ua amataina le mala.

verses.en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
verses.sm: Ona tago ai lea e Arona e pei ona fai atu ai e Mose, ua tamo‘e lava ia i totonu o le faapotopotoga ; faauta, ua amataina lava le mala i le nuu; ua ia avane foi mea manogi e mu, ma na fai ai le togiola mo le nuu.

verses.en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
verses.sm: Ua fcu foi o ia i le va o e oti ma e ola; ona taofia ai lea o le mala.

verses.en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
verses.sm: O i latou foi ua oti i le mala, o afe e tasi le sefulu ma le fa ma le fitu o selau, a Itoru.

verses.en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
verses.sm: Ona toe foi mai ai lea o Arona ia Mose i le faitotoa o le fale fetafai o le faapotopotoga; ua taofia foi le mala.
